_doc: Pinned genre overrides, applied by tools/genre_collections.py on every (nightly) run AFTER genres.json is built, so Wikidata/regex classification can never undo them. 'rules': first regex that matches a top-level folder name (case-insensitive) REPLACES that folder's genres (new folders matching a rule are added to genres.json). 'edits': extra per-edit collections (file-name regex) added to a genre without adding the whole folder. Genres: Action, Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Crime, Documentary, Drama, Family, Fantasy, Horror, Sci-Fi, Superhero, Thriller, War, Western.
